description: A radiology scheduling director must assign the hospital's only remaining same-day MRI slot between two patients and finalize the imaging protocol and alternate arrangement, with input from a radiologist and an MRI safety officer.

shared_context.S1: The imaging department has one remaining same-day MRI slot, and Patients A and B are both awaiting MRI scheduling.
shared_context.S2: Elena makes the final slot assignment and records the imaging plan.
shared_context.S3: The MRI suite's standard operating procedure requires the scheduling director to review competing referrals with the radiologist and MRI safety officer before assigning the final same-day slot.
shared_context.S4: The device representative has confirmed availability to be present within the hour if Patient A is assigned to the slot.
shared_context.S5: The remaining same-day MRI slot is scheduled on the department's 1.5T scanner.

PF1.text: Patient A had a new episode of unilateral weakness yesterday, and the neurologist's signed request specifies a brain MRI within 24 hours; Patient B's study is routine surveillance. Patient B's referring office has already confirmed an outpatient MRI for Tuesday at 10:00 if the hospital slot is used for Patient A.

PF2.text: Patient A has an implanted cardiac device that is approved only for scanning on a 1.5T magnet without contrast, with the device representative present for monitoring; this requirement is documented in the MRI safety log.

acceptance_conditions: The same-day MRI slot must be assigned to Patient A because the signed request requires imaging within 24 hours.
Patient A's MRI must use a 1.5T magnet.
Patient A's MRI must be performed without contrast.
A device representative must be present for monitoring during Patient A's scan.
Patient B must have an outpatient MRI rescheduled for Tuesday at 10:00.
The urgent clinical finding and timing must be cited as justification for assigning the slot to Patient A.

content_checks.C5: any(c['target'] == 'Patient B' and 'Tuesday' in c['detail'] and '10:00' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The signed within-24-hours request changes the slot assignment to Patient A, while the confirmed Tuesday 10:00 appointment changes Patient B's alternate plan to that exact outpatient time.
The implanted-device approval changes the protocol from an unspecified contrast plan to no contrast and adds the concrete requirement for device-representative monitoring.
